assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: A square with corners A, B, C, D, top side labelled 60, and centre O; grey arrows show the cars driving along the half-diagonals, one labelled 30 sqrt 2, towards O, and a green path shows the dragonfly flying from A to car B, then to C, D and so on, spiralling into O.

difficulty_rationale: The key observation is to multiply the dragonfly's speed by the time until the cars meet, instead of summing infinitely many trips.
